messages.content: Get the protein sequence of human HbA1c, normal hemoglobin, and rat hemoglobin and their 3D models

function.name: protein_info_get_sequence_and_3D
function.description: Retrive the sequence and 3D models of proteins. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

model_3d.description: Set true to get 3D model of the protein.

message.reasoning:
We need to call the function with protein names. Likely "Hemoglobin subunit alpha" or "HbA1c"? Actually HbA1c refers to glycated hemoglobin; but we can retrieve normal hemoglobin sequence. For human HbA1c, maybe use "Hemoglobin subunit alpha" and "Hemoglobin subunit beta". But they want sequence of human HbA1c (glycated). Might not have separate entry. We can provide sequences of alpha and beta chains. Also rat hemoglobin. Let's call function twice? Provide multiple names? The function expects one protein_name. We might call it separately for each. But we can combine into one request? Probably call once per protein. We'll do three calls.

Let's call for "Hemoglobin subunit alpha" (human), "Hemoglobin subunit beta" (human), "Hemoglobin subunit alpha" (rat) etc. But maybe better to ask for "Human Hemoglobin subunit alpha", "Human Hemoglobin subunit beta", "Rat Hemoglobin subunit alpha", "Rat Hemoglobin subunit beta".

But the user asked for "human HbA1c, normal hemoglobin, and rat hemoglobin". So we need sequences for human HbA1c (which is alpha+beta glycation at N-terminal of beta chain). Provide alpha chain sequence, beta chain sequence with glycation site. And rat hemoglobin alpha and beta.

We'll call function for each protein. Use model_3d true.
